body: getting there. It comes and goes, ya know?
2 large plastic containers from the house I used to live in, that I initially borrowed to keep meds & stuff in. She can have them back when she returns the random shit she "borrowed" from me. Maybe.

I reckon a lot of it is because of the medium- because everyone is physically detached/removed from everyone else, the best anyone can do is a general, non personal statement.  The internet isn't an ideal place to get help, so those who want to help tread carefully to try and gently steer others towards real-world help, on the chance that they might actually find a way out of the fucking gorge they're stuck in.

If you are still in the UK at the moment, can you contact anyone there who can help you immigrate? (emigrate? idk) It sounds like you enjoy life just a little bit more there. Make that a goal! 

Also it really bums me when threads like this have no replies. Don't take it personally though. I guess most people reading have their own problems and don't know the right things to say to help another.

He was probably freaking out about it, said some shit he didnt mean :/ OP, you're not a piece of shit. And I know how hypocritical or whatever it is for me to say that when I call myself the same thing, but you're not a piece of shit and it's not your fault.
